rationale: CR-001 is resolved: the working-tree endpoint strips blank cost_center_ids values before UUID validation, and the CR-001-mapped focused test run and live requests confirm empty values now behave as no filter while invalid UUID input remains rejected.

business_review.item: AC1: GET project list accepts a repeated cost_center_ids query parameter
business_review.notes: Endpoint declares a list-valued UUID query parameter; repeated values pass through.

business_review.item: AC2: Omitted or empty cost_center_ids applies no Cost Center filter (existing behavior unchanged)
business_review.notes: Omitted is unfiltered; a bare empty value fails UUID validation with 422.

business_review.item: AC3: With one or more IDs, only projects assigned to at least one selected Cost Center are returned
business_review.notes: Repository applies the cost-center IN predicate to the filtered project queries.

business_review.item: AC4: IDs pass through project_visibility_service.py unchanged; existing visibility rules still apply
business_review.notes: The service forwards the IDs and existing visibility branches remain in place.

business_review.item: AC5: Cost Center predicate applied to both page query and count query
business_review.notes: Predicate is applied to both count and page statements.

business_review.item: AC6: Filter combines with existing search and budget filters using AND
business_review.notes: Chained query predicates compose with AND.

business_review.item: AC7: No new environment variables or configuration
business_review.notes: No configuration changes are part of the diff.

findings.title: Empty cost-center filter returns 422
findings.problem: A bare cost_center_ids= query value is not normalized away before UUID parsing, so the empty string fails validation.
findings.impact: The required empty-filter behavior regresses: clients receive 422 instead of an unfiltered project list.
findings.recommendation: Normalize empty query values before UUID validation so an empty value applies no filter.

finding_status.notes: Working-tree BeforeValidator removes blank values before UUID parsing; the finding-mapped test and live requests confirm empty input returns the unfiltered result, while invalid UUID still returns 422.
